column2: It has been one year since Hyo Imawano took control of Justice High in an effort to eventually rule Japan. Life has returned to normal for everyone and people have forgotten his evil schemes...

Batsu, Hinata, and Kyosuke have graduated to the second grade. Since rescuing his mother, Batsu has had time to overcome the stress of changing school. He has finally been able to assimilate into his new school and has even made friends with his class mates. One day, an athletic event they've been waiting for called the "Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition" was held. However... In the middle of the event, people's shouts of joy were suddenly drowned out by screams of fear!

Students of Pacific High began to cause trouble at the event and in the end, many Taiyo High students were injured. BATSU: "What's their problem!?" Intending to find out what's behind the vicious attack, Batsu and his friends began their investigation...

Shoma, Natsu and Roberto have graduated to the second grade, and Nagare and Shuichi have entered the newly-established "Gorin University". As they spend more and more time in their own club activities, they end up spending less and less time together.

One day when three of them are coming home from school together... ??: "Somebody help! Heeeeelp please!" Reacting to the sudden scream, Shoma and his friends started running to help before they have time to think...

Roy and Tiffany went back to the states after last year's incident at Justice High. Since then, Pacific High appeared to have lost its spirit. Only Boman who graduated to the second grade, stayed at the school and tried to keep school spirit alive. He decided to participate in the "Taiyo-Pacific athletic competition" in order to try and raise school spirit.

But at the athletic competition, a horrible incident occurred. Pacific High students caused many problems and eventually the crowd got out of hand. In spite of Boman's desperate effort to stop them, Taiyo High's students fell one after another... BOMAN: "I must stop this!"

The big boss of Gedo High, Daigo Kazama who was embarrassed at the fact Hyo Imawano controlled him, has been missing since giving his exit notice. On top of that, Akira was transferred to a girls' high school. So Edge and Gan, although they graduated to the second grade, were left feeling somewhat empty...

Then all of a sudden, Daigo has appeared in front of them. While Edge and the others were pleased to see their boss return, Daigo gave strange orders... DAIGO: "All schools must surrender to us!! They will become our loyal soldiers!!" Hearing this kind of never-before-heard-of fierce order from Daigo, the students of Gedo High got enthusiastic. The students finally felt that Gedo High was back and ready to take control...

Thanks to the effort from the school president Raizo Imawano, Justice High has recovered from confusion and has regained its place as a super elite school. Hideo and Kyoko have been reconciled with Raizo and have gone back to teaching.

But then, some shocking news suddenly struck the school and broken its newfound peace... NEWS HEADER: "The school president Raizo Imawano was attacked by an unknown person!!" Raizo, lying on a bed, gives instructions to Hideo and Kyoko. He tells them to investigate and if there's a possibility of harm to the school, to use their judgment. Sensing something evil is at work, the two embark upon their investigation...

Akira Kazama was transferred from Gedo High to Seijyun Girls' High and she graduated to the second grade. She could not tell her classmates that she came from a boys' high school and thus was under a lot of stress. But one of her classmates, Yurika Kirishima supported her and has become an important friend of Akira.

One day, Akira confessed her trouble to her, saying she senses something wrong with her brother Daigo who has just come back from his long journey of training. Yurika suggested that Akira and her should investigate and so they both went to see a person called Zaki for help...

EXTERMINATE THE IMAWANO FAMILY!! As a punishment for putting the Darkside Society Organization at risk of exposure to the public, the D.S.O. ordered the immediate execution of Raizo Imawano, Hyo Imawano, Batsu Ichimonji and Kyosuke Kagami. However, the D.S.O.'s assassin, Kurow Kirishima had his own agenda...

Kurow wants to rule Japan. In order to do this, he realized that he must destroy both the Imawano family and the Darkside Society Organization. Several months have passed since he first began his mission, and now all of his evil plans are about to unfold...
